text:
Shani Shingnapur, Maharashtra: homes here have door frames but no doors, and since January 2011 a UCO Bank branch has operated with a front door that is never locked.

Why it matters: even where social trust replaces locks, the bank still keeps its cash in a strongroom. Trust shapes how a place is built, but the asset that matters most still gets hard security. Every buyer weighs open, community-run living against private, secured living.

Source: Deccan Herald / IANS (2011), Daily FT (2011), Taipei Times (2015).

Which would you choose for your own home?
